from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    pattern_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] not in (background, 0)]
    target_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                    if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pattern_cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in pattern_cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pattern_cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in pattern_cells)
    tr0 = min(r for r, c in target_cells)
    tc0 = min(c for r, c in target_cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(r1 - r0 + 1):
        for j in range(c1 - c0 + 1):
            out[tr0 + i][tc0 + j] = grid[r0 + i][c1 - j]
    return out
'''
